Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
X_Zealot wrote:
> If my only archbishop is sterile, am I allowed to play Shock Troops?
> I figured you could, but I just wanted to ask.

Yep. Card text aside, the Archbishop isn't the one siring the shock
troops - he just gives the order that they be sired (which is also
one of the reasons why the STs are clanless instead of matching the
AB's clan).
